A human arm/hand is visible in the background, appearing to hold or guide the iron. The background is cluttered with household items, including boxes and a bottle. There is yellow text overlay in the bottom right corner.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture on the arm appears overly smooth and 'waxy,' lacking fine pore detail or hair, which is common in AI generation or heavy filtering. The boundary between the arm and the background objects is slightly soft.
The yellow text 'Sam...' (or similar) is stylized but lacks crisp edges and clear typographic structure, appearing somewhat melted into the background texture.
The geometry of the background items is slightly ambiguous and warped, lacking precise straight lines expected from rigid cardboard boxes.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is indeed an iron and not a similar-looking tool (e.g., heat gun, shoe shiner) given the unusual angle.
To verify the physical continuity of the metal plate and check for melting/fusion artifacts at the edge where it meets the plastic body.
To analyze the waxy texture and structural integrity of the limb, checking for subtle anatomical errors or generation artifacts.
